description: Kansas motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Kansas?
questions.explanation: State law lists Kansas as requiring a helmet for riders 17 and younger.

questions.q: A Kansas rider who is age 18 or older
options: Must wear one on every trip
questions.explanation: The Kansas age rule is aimed at riders 17 and younger. Some states add a novice or insurance condition, so read the statute before riding without a helmet.

questions.q: What does Kansas law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: Kansas: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

questions.q: In Kansas, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Kansas issues a motorcycle permit at 14 years at the earliest.
